question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Vice
solution:
The correct answer is '*Immorality'*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct meaning of '**vice' **is '**criminal activities involving prostitution', 'pornography, or drugs'.**
 
• Whereas the meaning of** 'immorality'** is '**behavior that is morally wrong or 'outside society's standards of what is acceptable.**
 
• So the meaning of the above two words is almost the same.
 
• Hence the synonym of '**Vice'** is **'immorality'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__Let's look at the meaning of other words:

 
• '**Wrong'** is '**not correct or true'; 'incorrect'.**
 
• **'Looseness'** is '**The quality or fact of being free from rigidity', attachment, or restraint; not tight, not firmly attached, or taut.**
 
• '**Villainy'** is '**wicked or criminal behavior'.**
